mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_CALENDAR_POSITION_EVNT (schedule_sq, project_sq, company_sq) VALUES (#{scheduleSq}, #{projectSq}, #{companySq})
mapper.select: SELECT pj.project_sq AS projectSq, pj.company_sq AS companySq, pj.project_ttl AS projectTtl, pj.project_recruit_start_dt AS recruitStartDt, pj.project_recruit_end_dt AS recruitEndDt FROM TBL_CALENDAR_POSITION_EVNT cpe JOIN TBL_PROJECT_M pj ON pj.project_sq = cpe.project_sq WHERE cpe.schedule_sq = #{scheduleSq} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_SCHEDULE_EVNT AS se JOIN TBL_CALENDAR_POSITION_EVNT AS cpe ON se.scheduleSq = cpe.scheduleSq SET schedule_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE se.schedule_user_sq = #{userSq} AND cpe.company_sq = #{companySq} AND se.schedule_is_deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE TBL_SCHEDULE_EVNT AS se JOIN TBL_CALENDAR_POSITION_EVNT AS cpe ON se.schedule_sq = cpe.schedule_sq SET se.schedule_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE se.schedule_user_sq = #{userSq} AND cpe.project_sq = #{projectSq} AND se.schedule_is_deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE TBL_SCHEDULE_EVNT se JOIN TBL_CALENDAR_POSITION_EVNT cpe ON cpe.schedule_sq = se.schedule_sq SET se.schedule_is_deleted_yn = 'N', se.calendar_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE se.schedule_user_sq = #{userSq} AND cpe.project_sq = #{projectSq} AND se.schedule_is_deleted_yn = 'Y'
